name: Jira
description: Loads the projects in a Jira Cloud site and the issues of a project or a JQL search, one record per issue with its status, people, dates, labels and components.
introductoryText:
![Jira](data:image/png;base64,)

Loads the **projects** visible to your Jira Cloud account and, when you name a project or write a JQL filter, its **issues**: one record per issue with its key, type, summary, status, priority, assignee, reporter, dates, labels, components and fix versions.

**How to set it up**
1. Create an API token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens.
2. Enter your Jira site (`your-company` for https://your-company.atlassian.net), your Atlassian e-mail address and the token.
3. Enter a project key (such as `SHOP`), a JQL filter, or both. Leave both empty to load the projects only.

Every page of results is loaded. Dates come out as dates (UTC); lists such as labels are joined with commas. Add custom fields by their id under **Extra fields**.

options.name: jiraInstance
options.title: Jira site
options.description: Your Jira Cloud site: the part before .atlassian.net (your-company for https://your-company.atlassian.net), or the whole address.

options.name: username
options.title: Username
options.description: The e-mail address you sign in to Atlassian with.

options.name: apiKey
options.title: API token
options.description: Create one at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. The block can see what this account can see.

options.name: projectID
options.title: Project key
options.description: Load the issues of this project, such as SHOP (a project id also works). Leave empty to load projects only, or to use the JQL filter alone.

options.name: jql
options.title: JQL filter
options.description: Optional Jira Query Language condition, such as status != Done AND created >= -30d. Combined with the project key when both are set; may end with ORDER BY.

options.name: extraFields
options.title: Extra fields
options.description: Optional comma-separated Jira field ids to add as fields, such as customfield_10016 or environment. Values are written as text or numbers; objects by their name, lists joined with commas.

blockOutputs.label: Projects
blockOutputs.tooltip: The projects the account can see: id, key, name, type, category

blockOutputs.label: Issues
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per issue of the project or JQL filter; empty unless one of them is set
